capabilities: Convert selected measurements via command or context menu
Show hover previews of conversions without editing the note
Configure target system, units, precision, and US/UK liquid measures
Parse abbreviations, spelled-out units, ranges, fractions, and temperatures
extras: Installable from the Community plugins browser; the author accepts coffee donations. Known limitations include heuristic parsing of ambiguous text and non-exhaustive localized aliases.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to recognize and convert measurement values in text between imperial and metric units.
summary: Unit-conversion tool that converts measurements between imperial and metric systems inside notes, via commands, hover previews, or paste.
